title: S3 Records, Retention and Archive Rules

entries.name: As-Built Models and Records
entries.immutability: Frozen and write-locked at project completion.

entries.name: Active project retention
entries.value: Maintain project data online in ACC throughout active delivery.

entries.name: Post-completion retention
entries.value: 12 years post-completion or longer if the project contract/statutory limitation requires it.

entries.name: Post-closeout correction
entries.value: Direct modification prohibited; use a versioned addendum under a new transmittal.

provenance.migration_note: Retention values are migration candidates from the source and remain subordinate to project contractual/statutory requirements.
